race.comment: STARBOARD (1) is the one to beat after running second at this track last start, beaten just under a length despite racing wide throughout. Suspect he will relish the rise to 1500m third-up. SWITCHBLADE (8) comes through the same race where he finished alongside STARBOARD, adding to a sound record at this venue. He has to turn the tables on STARBOARD. CHEERFUL CAT (5) has been around the mark and the 3kg claim make him a genuine danger. ROYAL DIPLOMAT (4) disappointed as favourite at the Sunshine Coast, yet his Dalby maiden win was dominant and the claiming rider who has won on him returns. SONIC FLYER (9) also deserves respect after some strong recent efforts but will need a clever steer from out there.
